text_block_list.name: Musician
text_block_list.text:
Next track! Let's go!!
One, two! One, two, three, four!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Ah, this is so fun...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (This sense of unity is truly the best part of a live show!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, a gentle, mellow track...
I see, it's almost time for the end...)
(WHEEEEN!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes!
A killer tune right here!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(What is this, it's incredible...!
My heart, my body... they're bouncing to the beat on their own!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I can't stop!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!!
Ah, I shouted so much my throat is totally parched!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
That was sooooo insanely amazing!
Everyone became one!
I got a huge burst of power from that!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That really was a wonderful experience.
Thanks for inviting us along, Kiseki-san.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! Seeing everyone have such a great time
makes me so happy too, and—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
Why don't we try it out too?! A band!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm in! I definitely want to try!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright! First come, first served for roles!
I claim guitar!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Boo wants to play the drums~!
I'll hype everyone up with a fun rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take the bass.
Steady, solid, yet refined.
Seeing it up on stage earlier really struck a chord with me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to do lead guitar and vocals!
Just like earlier, I want to try completely transforming
the venue's atmosphere right from the front row!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All the pieces are in place!
Let's start our band!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yeah—!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, playing bass really is wonderful.
I have my hands full just trying to pluck a note, but...
every time it resonates, I feel a fresh sense of wonder.

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe♪ There's something so nice about this!
Starting together on the count of three and progressing side by side feels super fun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep polishing our skills at this pace!
Let's charge through our level-up phase with smiles on our faces!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It felt like we almost nailed syncing right before the chorus...
Let's do it one more time from the beginning—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Eye-san is totally fired up. Since we're doing this,
it would be lovely to perform in front of an audience someday.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd say that! Actually, I've already secured
a stage for our debut performance!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the connections I made while gathering reference material for my manga drawing, I managed to book a live music club~!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, Kiseki! Our music will reach everyone already!
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my!
Fufu, then we truly must give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(A live show... If we're going to play in front of an audience,
I need to practice even harder and improve much more...!)

After school. Intrigued by a melody coming from an empty classroom,
I peered inside to see what was happening—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The BPM is spot on. Each note's articulation is... aligned.
I should be getting better, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It falls completely short of that overwhelming heat
I felt on that day.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(The more I strive for perfection, the further away
I feel from that raw rush of emotion...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes! I formed a band with Lala and the others!
We have an upcoming live performance!
Trainer, please come see us play!

Forming a band with friends is supposed to be fun...
Yet she seemed to be pushing herself far too hard.
choice_data_list: Make sure to enjoy the band to the fullest

text_block_list.text:
Forming a band with friends is supposed to be fun...
Yet she seemed to be pushing herself far too hard.
choice_data_list: Make sure to enjoy the band to the fullest

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Of course, that's the plan.
However—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Rather than just 'fun', what I want them to feel most
is an unstoppable, irresistible surge of raw emotion.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Look forward to a performance that will shake your very soul!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was rehearsing with everyone until just a moment ago.
Right now, I'm doing self-practice because I want to hone my skills further!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm taking on both vocals and guitar.
I must work more than twice as hard as everyone else!
